1432-4222-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Ioreth of the Healing House.
Ioreth of the Healing House does not have summoning sickness.
1432-4222-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
1432-4222-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat from step 1

339-677-5686-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha, creating a Blood token
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3899-7084-8293.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1385-2393-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-2393-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

147-3905-5256.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3905-5256.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing a player to mill card(s).
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1575-2981-5903.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

339-677-4460-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-4460-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

4475-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher cannot be blocked by an opponent.
4475-5944.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Unstoppable Slasher
Unstoppable Slasher triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
The opponent dealt combat damage loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1003-4053-5330-6989.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3817-3991-5231.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2079-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3951-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2034-3951-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2054-2423-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Bounding Krasis
2054-2423-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Bounding Krasis with haste.
When the token Bounding Krasis enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bounding Krasis trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Bounding Krasis, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Bounding Krasis for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1309-2061-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Walk each turn.
1309-2061-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1124-2937-4554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
1124-2937-4554.description:
Activate Xenagos' first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, adding {R} or {G} for each creature you control.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of each of your planeswalkers this turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.
1124-2937-4554.notes: If you control five or more creatures, this combo will net infinite mana, and you may then activate any of Xenagos' other abilities.

2440-3490-5767.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact and/or creature.
2440-3490-5767.description:
Activate Dreadmobile by paying {1} and sacrificing another artifact or creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dreadmobile.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Repeat.
If you control two or more Servos as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

396-851-1409-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
396-851-1409-4050.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

731-1819-2503.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
Corrupted Conscience attached to Syr Konrad.
731-1819-2503.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library and then shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

2026-2404-2645.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five creatures.
2026-2404-2645.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1000-2743-3426.manaNeeded: {3}{G}{G}{U}, plus an additional {1} if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
1000-2743-3426.description:
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Biovisionary.
Resolve the Deranged Hermit trigger, creating four Biovisionary tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

429-679-4067.description:
Activate Pristine Talisman by tapping it, adding {C} and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Pristine Talisman.
Repeat.

4475-4794.description:
Cast Fraying Omnipotence by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to lose half their life, then discard half the cards in their hand, then sacrifice half the creatures they control, rounding up each time.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they have lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1090-2781.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Restoration Angel.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.
